pages.text: If a Spore Creature exists for more than 5 minutes, it might evolve into a more dangerous form. Evolving Spore Creatures is required for them to drop Armor Fragments once killed, which are an important component for various purposes. However, an Evolved Spore Creature existing for 10 minutes may evolve again, into its Hyper Evolved form.

This should be avoided as Hyper Evolved Spore Creatures are very destructive and pose a high risk of containment breach. It is recommended to make sure Spore Creatures are disposed of before they reach their Hyper Evolved form.
